_comment: NSE surveillance measures. ASM = Additional Surveillance Measure, GSM = Graded Surveillance Measure. Names here are excluded from every screen: a stock under surveillance is one the platform should not be forming a view on, which is an eligibility question rather than an opinion about the setup. Refresh from https://www.nseindia.com/reports/asm and /reports/gsm — NSE serves those behind a browser-shaped session, so this is bundled rather than fetched. Update `as_of` when you refresh, because a stale list under-excludes silently.
